stage0029_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$マオ$$
「They seem well trained.
　No gaps in how the units coordinate」

stage0029_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Oh! Their captain,
　is about to give a speech!」

stage0029_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
Akagi
「Hello, everyone who's come out today.
　I'm $$赤城龍之介$$, captain of the Nerima Red Dragon!」

stage0029_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$赤城$$
「Now, I'll show you all
　the Nerima Red Dragon's
　magnificent tactics」

stage0029_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$赤城$$
「Battle means always reading two or three moves ahead.
　And a difference in machine spec
　isn't what decides the fight」

stage0029_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$赤城$$
「When the reckless fool who challenges us
　asks the reason for their own defeat, I'll answer like this」

stage0029_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$赤城$$
「Because he's just a kid, I'll say!」

stage0029_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$エマ$$
「Sounds like he's forcing his lines together,
　into something that barely passes for a speech」

stage0029_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$アムロ$$... could that be him...」

stage0029_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$谷川$$
「Get him, $$赤木$$!
　Show them $$２１世紀警備保障$$'s pride!」

stage0029_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$佐伯$$
「It's all right, $$赤木$$!
　Follow my instructions and we're sure to win!」

stage0029_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Come on, $$シンジ$$!
　You have to cheer for $$赤木$$!」

stage0029_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$赤城$$
「So you've come, Akaten!
　Is that M6 your wingman!?」

stage0029_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$いぶき$$
（Is $$宗介$$'s side really all right?）

stage0029_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$青山$$
（It's a battle with dummy rounds,
　so there shouldn't be any danger）

stage0029_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$かなめ$$
（W, wait, Sousuke...!
　Are you serious!?）

stage0029_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$宗介$$
（No problem.
　This M6 is Far East branch spec: it has two seats）

stage0029_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$宗介$$
（You doubted my skill as a professional.
　So you have a duty to see the truth yourself）

stage0029_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$かなめ$$
（But if we're doing this, we're winning for sure!
　For $$風間$$'s sake too!）

stage0029_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ミサト$$
「The big showdown, $$赤木$$ vs $$赤木$$!
　If I'd called our $$リツコ$$ too,
　it'd have been a three way brawl, what a shame!」

stage0029_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$シンジ$$
「$$ミサト$$... you're drunk again, aren't you」

stage0029_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$ミサト$$
「It's a festival, after all.
　Not drinking would be a waste」

stage0029_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Sorry, $$オードリー$$...!
　I'm late!」

stage0029_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$アマタ$$
「The crepe stand was packed,
　so I got this instead」

stage0029_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$バナージ$$
「They're called takoyaki.
　Apparently a traditional Japanese soul food」

stage0029_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$飯塚$$
「Now then, I'll explain the rules.
　Each side's territory has a point set」

stage0029_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$飯塚$$
「Whoever seizes the enemy's point,
　or disables 50% of their force first, wins」

stage0029_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$甲児$$
「50%, huh. So for us, that means
　if either one goes down, we lose!?」

stage0029_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$竜馬$$
「This oughta be good.
　So what'll it be, $$赤木$$, $$宗介$$?」

stage0029_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$いぶき$$
「Hold on!
　Those terms are unfair to us!」

stage0029_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$赤木$$
「It's fine, $$いぶき$$!
　Neither me nor $$宗介$$ will ever lose!」

stage0029_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$青山$$
「Easy for you to say, but if we lose,
　it drags the company's name through the mud」

stage0029_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$いぶき$$
「And then a pay cut is guaranteed!」

stage0029_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$赤城$$
「Too late for regrets, Akaten!
　You civilians should've just stayed quiet!」

stage0029_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$赤木$$
「Here we go, Nerima radish!
　I'll show you that even
　a salaryman can protect the peace!」

stage0029_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$赤城$$
「Impossible!
　The Nerima Red Dragon, defeated!?」

stage0029_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$赤城$$
「Damn it!
　Is $$２１世紀警備保障$$'s robot a monster!?」

stage0029_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$赤木$$
「See that, Red Dragon!
　Lose to Akaten and you're the one who flunks!」

stage0029_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$赤城$$
「...I don't want to admit it...
　that this is a mistake born of my own youth...」

stage0029_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$赤城$$
「Damn it!
　Is $$２１世紀警備保障$$'s robot a monster!?」

stage0029_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$赤木$$
「See that, Red Dragon!
　Lose to Akaten and you're the one who flunks!」

stage0029_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$赤城$$
「...I don't want to admit it...
　that this is a mistake born of my own youth...」

stage0029_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$赤木$$
「All right!
　I've taken the point!」

stage0029_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$赤城$$
「Damn it!
　Is $$２１世紀警備保障$$'s robot a monster!?」

stage0029_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$赤木$$
「See that, Red Dragon!
　Lose to Akaten and you're the one who flunks!」

stage0029_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$赤城$$
「...I don't want to admit it...
　that this is a mistake born of my own youth...」

stage0029_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$桂$$
「That black Axio!
　Is that the 《$$ファイヤバグ$$》!?」

stage0029_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$クルツ$$
「This is bad!
　That Balarant's got $$ＰＳ$$ too!」

stage0029_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
Firebug Trooper
「Good, we're in combat range.
　All units, your targets are clear?」

stage0029_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Damn it... why do I have to
　help out with a kidnapping...!」

stage0029_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
Firebug Trooper
「You've no right to complain.
　Don't forget the debt for being picked up, $$カン・ユー$$」

stage0029_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「I know that!
　With this $$エクルビス$$, taken from Balarant
　as severance pay, I'll show my true skill!」

stage0029_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$カレン$$
「Is that $$カン・ユー$$ piloting that AT!?」

stage0029_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Seems he's still after $$キリコ$$, even now」

stage0029_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
Firebug Trooper
「Now then, there's only one target...!」

stage0029_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
Firebug Trooper
「We already looked into it!
　That girl is our new $$姫$$!」

stage0029_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$クラン$$
「Looks like the enemy's after the M6!」

stage0029_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$アルト$$
「They mean to kidnap $$かなめ$$!?」

stage0029_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$宗介$$
「Damn terrorists...!
　To strike at a time like this...!」

stage0029_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$かなめ$$
「S, Sousuke!
　You're a professional, right!
　You can beat guys like that easy, right!」

stage0029_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$宗介$$
「I am indeed a professional,
　but I'm no war movie hero.
　Protecting you and winning unscathed is impossible」

stage0029_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I, I'll be fine, so don't worry!」

stage0029_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$宗介$$
「No, Chidori.
　I fight in order to protect you.
　I can't do anything that puts you in danger」

stage0029_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$青山$$
「This is bad!
　Even $$宗介$$ can't fight in an AS
　loaded with only dummy rounds!」

stage0029_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$赤木$$
「But if we can't draw their eyes away somehow,
　we can't even withdraw!」

stage0029_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
Narashino Base Trooper
「All units, begin the attack!」

stage0029_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
Narashino Base Trooper
「We'll hold the enemy back!
　Nerima Red Dragon, fall back!」

stage0029_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$赤城$$
「Not yet, this isn't over!
　I can still fight with only dummy rounds!」

stage0029_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
Narashino Base Trooper
「Don't lose sight of a soldier's duty!
　I won't allow a suicide charge before civilians!」

stage0029_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$赤木$$
「Red Dragon!
　Even without fighting, there's still something to do!
　So go and do it!」

stage0029_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$赤城$$
「I... let myself drown in combat skill,
　and lost sight of a soldier's duty...」

stage0029_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$赤城$$
「My thanks to Narashino Base's AS unit
　and to Mr. $$赤木駿介$$ for showing me that!」

stage0029_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$赤城$$
「Nerima Red Dragon, fall back!
　We'll guide the civilians to evacuate!」

stage0029_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$青山$$
「$$宗介$$! Fall back too while you still can!」

stage0029_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
Firebug Trooper
「Let the new $$姫$$ get away!?」

stage0029_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$赤木$$
「I'm fine here!
　Hurry up and fall back!」

stage0029_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$宗介$$
「But, in a situation like this...!」

stage0029_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$宗介$$
「This $$ボン太くん#robot$$ is the one I prepared...!
　Who's inside it!?」

stage0029_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$キリコ$$
「I knew you'd brought this AS along.
　This should let you fight.」

stage0029_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$キリコ$$
「I owe you for backup at $$マーティアル$$.
　I'll get that woman clear.」

stage0029_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$かなめ$$
（Ugh... an even bigger stone-face than Sousuke...）

stage0029_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$かなめ$$
「W-wait a second!
　I'm not ready yet...」

stage0029_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$いぶき$$
「Well, that was quite a sight...」

stage0029_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$青山$$
「$$キリコ$$, out of a mascot suit...
　That'd traumatize any kid who saw it...」

stage0029_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$赤木$$
「$$宗介$$!
　Can you do this!?」

stage0029_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$いぶき$$
「That's not $$宗介$$ anymore...
　That's $$ボン太くん#robot$$.」

stage0029_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$赤木$$
「All right, $$ボン太くん#robot$$!
　The others will be here soon!
　Until then, we hold them off ourselves!」

stage0029_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$赤木$$
「Everyone at Narashino Base!
　We'll hold them off!
　Please focus on defending the base!」

stage0029_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$飯塚$$
「Roger, Akaten!
　I'm counting on you!」

stage0029_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
Firebug Trooper
「Ha...!
　That rat's entrance left me stunned!」

stage0029_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「What are you talking about!
　That's obviously the invincible honey badger!」

stage0029_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
Firebug Trooper
「Who cares!
　Let's finish off that Fumoffu bastard
　and the salaryman who got in our way!」

stage0029_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$赤木$$
「I don't get what he's saying,
　but that's some serious confidence!」

stage0029_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$アルト$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, Bonta!
　I'll save you now!」

stage0029_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$クラン$$
「I told you to say 'kun', $$アルト$$!
　You forehead dummy!」

stage0029_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$オードリー$$
（What is this, my heart's racing...）

stage0029_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$ノイン$$
（Heh... I may dream like a girl again tonight）

stage0029_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Hey, $$カレン$$...
　How many raffle tickets do I need for that?」

stage0029_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$レイ#333$$
（I want to pet something fluffy...）

stage0029_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$スズネ$$
「As always, $$ボン太くん#robot$$'s a big hit.」

stage0029_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$n
「That's only until you learn who's inside, though.」

stage0029_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$カレン$$
「Um... $$キリコ$$, it suited you too...」

stage0029_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「A-anyway, wiping out the terrorists comes first.」

stage0029_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Guess even you two are shaken up.」

stage0029_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$キャシー$$
「I wonder if $$ファイヤバグ$$ is still
　targeting $$千鳥かなめ$$...」

stage0029_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「That's likely true, but
　their goal seems different from before.」

stage0029_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$ラム$$
「All the civilians who came to the base are
　safe, thanks to Nerima Red Dragon and
　$$２１世紀警備保障$$'s guidance.」

stage0029_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$ボビー$$
「This ought to remind that Nerima
　radish boy what a soldier's duty is.」

stage0029_04:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$モニカ$$
「By the way, what should we do...?
　The now-safe civilians are about to
　swarm $$ボン太くん#robot$$...」

stage0029_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「No good...!
　We must never let the civilians
　learn what's inside that thing!」

stage0029_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, withdraw at once!
　Guard $$ボン太くん#robot$$ from every side as you go!」

stage0029_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$赤城$$
「See that, Akaten!
　This is my ultimate Red Stream Attack!」

stage0029_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$赤木$$
「Daaamn it!
　At this rate, it's Akaten again!」

stage0029_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Argh, what an unwieldy machine!
　This is why I hate Balarant ATs!」

stage0029_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Remember this, $$キリコ$$!
　The day I master this machine
　will be your death day!」

stage0029_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$赤城$$
「Akaten!
　I've always wanted a fight like this!」

stage0029_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$赤城$$
「Instructor $$飯塚$$ told me this!
　My combat skills may surpass yours,
　but you have something I lack!」

stage0029_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$赤木$$
「I don't know what you're talking about,
　but once I've decided, I go all out!」

stage0029_04:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$赤城$$
「This is no joke!
　Don't think a civilian can beat a soldier!」

stage0029_04:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$赤木$$
「Civilian or soldier makes no difference
　to protecting peace! I won't let $$ダイ・ガード$$
　lose to a mere technique polisher!」

stage0029_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$赤城$$
「This fighting spirit...!
　So this is youth!」

stage0029_04:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$赤城$$
「Not bad, mystery intruder!
　Matching this Red Dragon blow for blow!」

stage0029_04:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Go, Sousuke!
　Charm that stuck-up Nerima radish down to size!」

stage0029_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$宗介$$
「Understood.
　I'll show you my skill as a professional!」

stage0029_04:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$宗介$$
「Chidori... if you feel sick or scared,
　don't hesitate to tell me.」

stage0029_04:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm fine.
　A mock battle's basically like airsoft, right?」

stage0029_04:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$かなめ$$
「More importantly, since you talked big,
　you'd better show me the goods!」

stage0029_04:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$宗介$$
「No problem.
　I'll just do things as I always do.」

stage0029_04:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$かなめ$$
（I know it's half play, but it's still scary...）

stage0029_04:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$かなめ$$
（So Sousuke and the others usually fight
　feeling even more scared than this...）

stage0029_04:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Can you hear me, Elements?
　Supreme Commander $$不動$$'s left the
　Element Change timing up to you.」

stage0029_04:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Change Elements as the situation
　demands, and fight!」

stage0029_04:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$アマタ$$
（I still don't get this world well,
　but if people need our strength,
　we'll fight with Aquarion...!）

stage0029_04:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$アルト$$
「I have no idea what you're saying!!」

stage0029_04:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「You sure took care of me at $$ア・コバ$$,
　$$キリコ$$! But today, I'm different!」

stage0029_04:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「You...!
　Not gonna say a word, huh!」

stage0029_04:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$キリコ$$
「I'm done with weird sounds coming out
　if I open my mouth wrong.」

stage0029_04:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Don't tell me, that honey badger earlier was...」

stage0029_04:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「It's been a while, $$カレン$$!
　I've got plenty of grudges against you!」

stage0029_04:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$カレン$$
「You're persistent too!
　Still sore about 《$$クメン$$》!」

stage0029_04:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「That's not all!
　That time, and that time, and that
　time, you turned against me!」

stage0029_04:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「If you won't kneel and apologize
　for that, I'll crush you right here!」

stage0029_04:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$カレン$$
「If you're bringing up old grudges,
　I've got something to say too!」

stage0029_04:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$カレン$$
「How dare you send me out as a
　bunny girl back at $$クメン$$!
　That was sexual harassment, plain!」

stage0029_04:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「That was an emergency, so...」

stage0029_04:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$カレン$$
「Shut up!
　I still remember that lecherous
　look in your eyes, even now!!」

stage0029_04:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I... I have to fight a machine
　with a person inside it...」

stage0029_04:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$シンジ$$, remember your training.
　You can do it.」

stage0029_04:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Are you telling me to kill someone!?」

stage0029_04:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$ミサト$$
「That's not it.
　There must be plenty of ways to disable them.」

stage0029_04:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
